title: Your Card Only Flips If It's Mutual 🃏
caption: in this world your card stays face down until it's mutual

scenes.text: In this world, when you turn eighteen, you get a card.
It has your face on it, but it stays face down.
It only flips when someone aligns with you, and you align back.
My sister's card flipped in a week.
Mine stayed face down for three years.
So I did something dumb. I painted a fake face on my card.
Because none of them were aligning with me.
Then one night, at eleven eleven, the whole deck reshuffled.
A girl at the bus stop held up her card. Face down too.
She said, I painted mine for a year.
So I scraped the paint off mine, and told her the honest thing.
I'm kind of boring, and I really like stars.
And both our cards flipped, at the exact same time.
